jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Eritrea has published no national AI law, AI strategy, AI guidance or data protection law. Official references to AI are limited to Ministry of Information news items, such as 2026 talks with UNESCO on AI in education, and there is no data protection authority, cybersecurity agency or standalone telecom regulator.
narrative.review_notes: This review was completed on 12 October 2026 and covers national law, government, ministries and regulators. Official sources were searched in English, Tigrinya and Arabic and no national AI governance documents were found; the official gazette is not online.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: The Ministry of Information's site (in English, Tigrinya and Arabic), government sources, ministries and regulators were searched at national level. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The Gazette of Eritrean Laws is not published online, so the absence of AI provisions in recent laws cannot be confirmed from the gazette itself.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. shabait.com (Ministry of Information) searched in English, Tigrinya and Arabic; Gazette of Eritrean Laws not online. AI mentions are news items only (not recorded). Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: Searched, nothing found. The Gazette of Eritrean Laws is not published online; Ministry of Information (shabait.com) searches in English, Tigrinya and Arabic found no AI law, AI provision, data protection law or cybersecurity proclamation text. No AI bills identified.; Government: Searched, nothing found. No national AI strategy, digital/ICT strategy with an AI pillar, or public-sector AI guidance published by the Government of Eritrea. Ministry of Information items mentioning AI (World Tourism Day 2026 theme, UNESCO delegation talks on AI in education, 28 May 2026) are news items with no policy document.; Ministries: Searched, nothing found for Transport and Communications, Education, Health, Justice, Defence, Finance, Labour and Human Welfare, Local Government; no ministry publishes AI documents online.; Regulators: Searched, nothing found. No data protection authority, no cybersecurity agency, no standalone telecom regulator (sector under the Ministry of Transport and Communications); Bank of Eritrea has no AI-specific publications online.. Not reached: none.
